data.summary:
This unit may use one Teleport Homer token:

- As the battle starts, you may place the token on the battlefield anywhere not in the deployment zone of your opponent.
- If you placed it, once per battle you may use the **[Rapid Ingress](vsdata:ability/core.rapid-ingress)** Stratagem on this unit for 0CP. When you resolve it, the unit is set up within 3" of the token and more than 8" from every enemy model; the token is then removed.
